cond_0001.intro: As a Mechanical Reliability Engineer, you will apply technical knowledge to deliver continuous improvement in principles and problem-solving techniques in asset reliability through the detection and elimination of defects. You will repair and perform preventive maintenance to ensure the most efficient operation while taking a proactive approach to new equipment installations. In this role, you will partner with the team on tasks ranging from simple part replacement, advanced troubleshooting and preventive/predictive maintenance ensuring that equipment is properly configured and/or set up.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Minimum of two years of related work experience
Knowledge in maintenance process management
Background in rotating equipment, seals, piping, pumps, fans, blowers and material handling equipment
Preferred Requirements
Experience creating complex tests and analysis
Predictive maintenance technologies experience
Experience with SAP

In this role, you will partner with the team on tasks ranging from simple part replacement, advanced troubleshooting and preventive/predictive maintenance ensuring that equipment is properly configured and/or set up.
cond_0120.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Around two years of related work experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Working knowledge of maintenance process management
Background in rotating equipment, seals, piping, pumps, fans, blowers and material handling equipment
Some experience creating tests and analysis; willingness to develop this further on the job
Familiarity with predictive maintenance technologies
Experience with SAP, or willingness to learn
cond_0120.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

You will regularly work with the team on tasks ranging from simple part replacement to advanced troubleshooting and preventive/predictive maintenance, staying in close contact with colleagues to ensure equipment is properly configured and set up. A regular part of the role is taking a proactive approach to new equipment installations and communicating with the team to keep operations running efficiently.
cond_0231.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, or electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Minimum of two years of related work experience in manufacturing environments or facilities.
Knowledge in maintenance process management.
Background in rotating equipment, seals, piping, pumps, fans, blowers, and material handling equipment.
Experience creating complex tests and analysis.
Predictive maintenance technologies experience.
Experience with SAP.
We are open to candidates from food manufacturing, oil, gas, mining, chemical manufacturing, or a military background.

You will repair and perform preventive maintenance to ensure the most efficient operation while taking a proactive approach to new equipment installations. In this role, you will partner with the team on tasks ranging from simple part replacement, advanced troubleshooting and preventive/predictive maintenance ensuring that equipment is properly configured and/or set up.
cond_0507.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
Around 1–2 years of experience within manufacturing environments, with some understanding of how equipment works and mechanical components
Working knowledge of maintenance process management
Background in rotating equipment, seals, piping, pumps, fans, blowers, and material handling equipment
Preferred Requirements
Experience creating tests and analysis
Familiarity with predictive maintenance technologies
Experience with SAP, or willingness to learn it
We are open to candidates from a range of industries including food manufacturing, oil, gas, mining, chemical manufacturing, and military backgrounds.

In this role, you will partner with the team on tasks ranging from simple part replacement, advanced troubleshooting and preventive/predictive maintenance ensuring that equipment is properly configured and/or set up.
cond_0533.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum of two years of demonstrated expertise in a related role within manufacturing environments.
Advanced knowledge of maintenance process management.
Extensive background in rotating equipment, seals, piping, pumps, fans, blowers and material handling equipment.
Proven track record creating complex tests and analysis.
Deep knowledge of predictive maintenance technologies.
Strong command of SAP.
cond_0533.workplace_support: We know there is no one-size-fits-all approach to work. That is why we support flexibility while also creating opportunities for people to connect, build community, and feel a sense of belonging at work.

You will repair and perform preventive maintenance to ensure the most efficient operation while taking a proactive approach to new equipment installations. In this role, you will partner with the team on tasks ranging from simple part replacement, advanced troubleshooting and preventive/predictive maintenance ensuring that equipment is properly configured and/or set up.
cond_0604.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Minimum of two years of related work experience
Knowledge in maintenance process management
Background in rotating equipment, seals, piping, pumps, fans, blowers and material handling equipment.
Experience creating complex tests and analysis.
Predictive maintenance technologies experience.
Experience with SAP.

In this role, you will partner with the team on tasks ranging from simple part replacement, advanced troubleshooting and preventive/predictive maintenance ensuring that equipment is properly configured and/or set up.
cond_0631.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Minimum of two years of related work experience
Knowledge in maintenance process management
Background in rotating equipment, seals, piping, pumps, fans, blowers and material handling equipment
Preferred Requirements
Experience creating complex tests and analysis
Predictive maintenance technologies experience
Experience with SAP

Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise within manufacturing environments, with a solid understanding of how equipment works, mechanical component design, and equipment breakdown mechanics

We are open to candidates from the following industries: food manufacturing, oil, gas, mining, chemical manufacturing, and military backgrounds.
